summary_1line: Bhishma concludes a fable about provoking the powerful, then teaches Yudhishthira that covetousness is the root of sin and countless moral corruptions.

image_candidates.scene_text: The furious Wind rushes through the forest, toppling great trees as it confronts the now-stripped Salmali tree standing bare and ashamed.
The once-mighty Salmali tree stands trunk-only, its branches lopped off, while the Wind hovers triumphantly around it.
Bhishma lies upon his bed of arrows addressing Yudhishthira while warriors gather around to hear his teaching about covetousness.
